title: Login API returns 401 after token refresh
description: A valid user session is rejected after the access token refreshes. The original request succeeds before refresh and fails afterwards.

title: Checkout total drops the delivery fee
description: The order summary occasionally omits the delivery fee after a discount is applied, causing the displayed total to differ from the payment amount.

title: Profile image upload hangs on larger files
description: The profile image form stays in a loading state after selecting a high-resolution image.

title: Search results reset when changing pages
description: Moving to the next page clears the active search term and returns unfiltered results.

title: Dashboard shows stale activity after saving
description: New activity does not appear until the browser is refreshed manually.

title: CSV import skips rows with accented names
description: Importing a UTF-8 CSV silently drops rows where a name contains an accented character.

title: Notification count does not clear on read
description: Opening a notification does not update the unread count until the next session.

title: Mobile navigation covers the save button
description: On narrow screens the open menu overlaps the primary save action in the settings form.

title: Report export returns an empty document
description: A report with several filtered results downloads successfully but has no rows.

title: Password reset link expires immediately
description: Recently generated password-reset links are treated as expired on first use.
